pages.text: Config file: $(item)config/easy_farms-common.toml$()$(br2)$(thing)timeMultiplier$() (1.0): multiplies every farm's cycle time. 2.0 is twice as slow.$(br2)$(thing)baseInputLifetimeDays$() (30): Minecraft days before the tool breaks (or, for toolless recipes, the inputs are used up) at the base tier.
Tool tiers, recipes and upgrade cards are datapack data, so a modpack can change them without code.
